title: Venetian Bronze Paper Towel Holder - 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Paper Towel Valet (5 X 14 X 5 In), Contemporary Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop dealing with tipping paper towel stands and cluttered counters—this freestanding countertop paper towel holder keeps a roll stable and always within reach — available in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. to coordinate with your kitchen.

  • Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Built for daily use: solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives
  • Keeps your counter organized: freestanding design requires no wall mounting

Specs

  • Product type: Countertop paper towel holder / paper towel valet
  • Mounting: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 5 x 14 x 5 in
  • Product weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included items: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

Complete your kitchen with coordinating pieces in matching finishes.
meta_description: 14-inch freestanding paper towel holder for kitchen countertops in solid brass with a weighted base and felt pad. Multiple lifetime designer finishes available.
